summary.agreement_count_scope: Descriptive count of selected visible word/cue sites, not independent evidence channels, accuracy, rarity or population metrics.

conclusion: At these selected visible sites, Fr20274 agrees with current corrected/standard C23 wording and common cues; it does not furnish an established shared uncorrected C23 error. The written hymn cue differs in scope. This does not exclude a wider transmission relationship or identify a copying direction, common exemplar, physical codex or unique branch.
